newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Richina sells car park division to Wilson.
newsitem.headline: Richina sells car park division to Wilson.

text.p: Richina Pacific Ltd said on Thursday it had reached an unconditional agreement to sell its car parking operations to Wilson Parking New Zealand, with settlement on Friday.
"While the precise terms of the sale remain confidential, Richina's investment in parking operations represents less than one percent of the assets of Richina," the company said.
It said Parking was a successful operation, but not a core activity to which Richina could add significant value. Almost all Mainzeal Parking staff were being offered employment by the new operator.
The transaction has received Commerce Commission approval, Richina said. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
